title: Systematic optimisation of the crypto sleeves and the portfolio construction (anti-overfit protocol)
registered: 2026-10-15, before any Gen72 number was computed
why: Several sleeves still run their first-guess parameters (premium carry 7/7 terciles, trend 4h 20/10 on BTC/ETH/SOL, cascade k=3 / OI -5% / limit 0.5%). The portfolio scales sleeves with full-sample volatility (mild look-ahead) and uses equal risk without looking at correlations. Gen72 tunes all of this under fixed rules.

selection_rule.per_sleeve: Every grid cell is scored on DEV only. Score = mean Sharpe of the cell and its immediate grid neighbours (+-1 step on each axis), so isolated peaks lose to plateaus. The best-scoring cell replaces the current default only if (a) its 2023-26 Sharpe is >= the default's AND (b) swapping it into v4 does not lower the v4 2022-26 Sharpe. Otherwise the default stays.
selection_rule.walk_forward_check: For 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026 separately, pick the best smoothed cell using only data before that year and stitch the out-of-sample years. If the walk-forward series beats the default on 2023-26, tuning this sleeve adds real value; if not, a change is reported as unproven even if it passed the rule above.
selection_rule.DEV: 2020-2022 for premium carry and trend 4h; 2022 only for the cascade (open-interest data starts 2021-12)

grids.premium carry: lookback {3, 7, 14, 21} days x hold {1, 3, 7, 14} days x bucket {terciles, quartiles}; default 7 / 7 / terciles (32 cells)
grids.trend 4h: (entry, exit) in {(10,5), (20,5), (20,10), (40,5), (40,10), (40,20), (60,10), (60,20), (60,30)} x coins {BTC/ETH/SOL, BTC/ETH/SOL/BNB/XRP/DOGE}; default (20,10) BTC/ETH/SOL (18 cells)
grids.cascade limit strict: sigma threshold k {2.5, 3.0, 3.5} x hold {6, 12, 24} h x limit {0.3%, 0.5%, 0.8%} x OI drop {3%, 5%}; trade-through 0.1%, max 3 open, 0.2 notional; default 3.0 / 12 / 0.5% / 5% (54 cells)

portfolio.P0: current v4 recipe (full-sample sleeve vols, equal risk) - reference only
portfolio.P1: point-in-time equal risk: each sleeve scaled with its trailing 365-day vol (min 90 days), known at the previous close
portfolio.P2: point-in-time inverse-variance-with-correlation (equal risk contribution, ERC) from the trailing 365-day covariance
portfolio.P3: point-in-time minimum variance (long-only weights, trailing 365-day covariance, shrinkage 50% to diagonal)
portfolio.rule: All use the same 30-day portfolio vol targeting (cap 1.5x) and the same sleeves. The method is chosen on 2022-2024 Sharpe and must not lose on HOLD 2025-26 vs P1; else P1 (the honest version of the current method) is used.
portfolio.sleeves: final sleeve set = C*, premium carry, cascade limit strict, trend 4h (each at the Gen72-selected settings) + Weiss expiry W1 at notional cap 0.5 (Gen70)

untouched: C* stays frozen (it is itself an ensemble of 19 lookbacks; earlier tuning rounds are in Gen32/Gen53). Weiss W1 has no free parameters.
output: research/GEN72_OPTIMISE.md, results/gen72_*.csv, full report with statistics, monthly heatmap, equity curve and prop simulation
